name: dlt-expert
description: Super Lotto (DLT) data analysis and number-picking assistant powered by official China Sport Lottery draw data

displayDescription.en: Powered by official China Sport Lottery draw data, maintains DLT history, analyzes hot/cold numbers and patterns, and generates smart picks for rational reference.
displayDescription.zh: 基于中国体彩官方开奖数据，提供大乐透历史数据维护、号码冷热分析、规律统计与智能选号，全程理性参考。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我更新大乐透最新开奖数据并分析
